description: This file contains functions related to system detection and configuration for Lantiq hardware, specifically checking device type and setting up DSL modules and interfaces.

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Checks if the system is a VDSL system based on CPU info.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Configures the DSL helper settings, detects the system type, and sets up WAN interface accordingly.
